readback.en: The proposition is that Consider every natural number $N$ and every intermediate field $K$ between $\mathbb Q$ and the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q(t)$, equipped with $u,v\in K$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$, and $K$ is finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q(u)$ of degree $N$. Assume that every proper valuation subring $O\subset K$ containing $\mathbb Q$ has residue field $\kappa(O)$ finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q$. For every point $x=(O,\sigma)$, with such $O$ and a ring homomorphism $\sigma:\kappa(O)\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$, and every $\varphi\in K$ regular at $O$ with $a=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_O\varphi)\ne0,1$, put $L=\sigma(\kappa(O))$ and $F=\mathbb Q(a)\subseteq L$. The finite dimensional structure of $L/\mathbb Q$ is that obtained from residue finiteness; the $F$-algebra structure on $L$ is induced by this actual inclusion. Write $n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$, $D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ and $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$, where $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ is the library finite set of prime ideals over the ideal $\mathfrak q$, and multiplicities and norms are cast to $\mathbb R$. For a finite place $v$ of $E$, $\mathfrak p_v$ denotes its associated nonzero prime ideal and $N(v)=|\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak p_v|$. For every finite place $u$ of the actual image field $F$, $\log N(u)/n_F\le\sum_{w\mid u}\log N(w)/n_L+\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak p_u)$. Here the sum ranges over all finite places of the actual point field $L$ above $u$; the left denominator is $n_F$, while each right denominator is $n_L$.

theorem finiteSetLogCond_le_of_local_and_accounting
    (hlocal : ∀ u : FinitePlace F,
      Real.log (placeNorm u) / finrank ℚ F ≤
        (∑ w ∈ placesOver L u, Real.log (placeNorm w) / finrank ℚ L) +
          diffContrib L u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal)
    (hfinite : (Function.support fun 𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F) =>
      diffContrib L 𝔭.asIdeal).Finite)
    (haccount : Real.log (Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L))) / finrank ℚ L =
      ∑ᶠ 𝔭 : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F), diffContrib L 𝔭.asIdeal)
    (S : Finset F) (T : Finset L) (hST : S.image (algebraMap F L) ⊆ T) :
    finiteSetLogCond S ≤ finiteSetLogCond T +
      Real.log (Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal (𝓞 F) (𝓞 L))) / finrank ℚ L := by
  classical
  set U := meetsFinset S
  set V := meetsFinset T
  have hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (U : Set (FinitePlace F)) (placesOver L) := by
    intro u₁ _ u₂ _ hne
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun w hw₁ hw₂ => hne ?_
    rw [eq_placeBelow (mem_placesOver.mp hw₁), eq_placeBelow (mem_placesOver.mp hw₂)]
  have hsub : U.biUnion (placesOver L) ⊆ V := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hwu⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hw
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hua⟩ := mem_meetsFinset.mp hu
    refine mem_meetsFinset.mpr ⟨algebraMap F L a,
      hST (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha), ?_⟩
    exact (one_lt_apply_algebraMap_iff (mem_placesOver.mp hwu) a).mpr hua
  rw [finiteSetLogCond_eq_sum, finiteSetLogCond_eq_sum, Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_div]
  calc ∑ u ∈ U, Real.log (placeNorm u) / finrank ℚ F
      ≤ ∑ u ∈ U, ((∑ w ∈ placesOver L u,
          Real.log (placeNorm w) / finrank ℚ L) +
            diffContrib L u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun u _ => hlocal u
    _ = (∑ w ∈ U.biUnion (placesOver L), Real.log (placeNorm w) / finrank ℚ L) +
          ∑ u ∈ U, diffContrib L u.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_biUnion hdisj]
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
        (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun w _ _ =>
          div_nonneg (log_placeNorm_nonneg w) (by positivity))
        (sum_diffContrib_le_of_accounting hfinite haccount U)

The finite dimensional structure of $L/\mathbb Q$ is that obtained from residue finiteness; the $F$-algebra structure on $L$ is induced by this actual inclusion. Write $n_E=[E:\mathbb Q]$, $D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ and $\delta_{L/F}(\mathfrak q)=\sum_{P\in\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)}\operatorname{multiplicity}_P(D_{L/F})\log|\mathcal O_L/P|/n_L$, where $\Pi_L(\mathfrak q)$ is the library finite set of prime ideals over the ideal $\mathfrak q$, and multiplicities and norms are cast to $\mathbb R$.
